fact: Libya's Prime Minister's Decision 23 of 2025, in force from issue, creates the Sunduq Intilaqa fund for seed finance (up to LYD 150,000 per company) and loan guarantees for startups, and defines a start-up in law.

The Libya Observer says Prime Minister Dbeibah announced in January 2025, under the 1,000 Entrepreneurs for 1,000 Projects initiative, a support fund and regulations governing startup companies; adoption of the regulations is not stated.
